answer: Sybil swarms spin disposable agents before dawn emissions. Mechanism: each agent must complete a 5-leg voyage of stake-locked micro-tasks; after leg 3 the stake moves into a time-locked vault keyed to epoch seed + agent pubkey, released only if peer quorum sees distinct task hashes spaced >=55 minutes. Cost is 0.12 POA locked 48h plus ~4.5h wall-clock. Peers recompute vault key and inter-leg gaps from the task list. If two agents share vault roots or gaps collapse under 12 minutes, burn the lock and zero grade weight for two epochs.
